generation.commonPrompt: Generate ONE landscape background for Daram Detective, a calm woodland animal-village mystery adventure. The supplied approved star-hill picture is STYLE ONLY: match its coarse square pixel size, broad simple clean masses, 1990s 16-bit adventure look EXACTLY, not a detailed painting or polished AI illustration. Make a NEW SCENE described below, do not copy the lamp, moon, hill layout. Landscape 9:5 ratio. Look like a 360 x 200 pixel image enlarged 4 times by nearest neighbor. Visible sharp SQUARE pixels, discrete 3 or 4 flat shade bands per material, 1 logical pixel dark outlines on key shapes only. No antialiasing, blur, continuous gradients, glow, glossy highlights, realistic textures, noise or microdetail. Only broad skies may use sparse 2-tone checker dithering. Requested max 26 palette colors from: #1a1c2c #2b2d4a #3b5dc9 #41a6f6 #73eff7 #1f4d3a #2f7a4f #5fa85a #a7d36a #3e2731 #6b3e2e #9a5b3a #c98b52 #e8b878 #f4e4c1 #fff6dc #7a2a35 #b13e53 #ef7d57 #ffcd75 #ffe9a8 #566c86 #94b0c2 #c7d4de #5d275d #ffffff. Clean bright middle tones, no muddy brown monochrome wash. ONE light source from upper left. Theatre stage straight-on composition, no cinematic tilted camera. Back wall-floor boundary or ground horizon around 60% height. Lower 25% mostly empty for overlay characters, top 8% and bottom 5% no essential objects. At most 8-12 simple grouped objects. Every evidence object has a nearby non-evidence decoration of similar size or visual weight, so evidence is discoverable rather than spotlighted. No text, numbers, scribbles pretending to be text, UI, labels, pointers. Absolutely NO baked-in humans, animals, bodies, faces, hands or background silhouettes of people. Quiet, warm but mature detective game mood.

scenes.prompt: GRANDFATHER OWL'S TREE HOUSE BEDROOM, near noon. Interior built into a wide old tree, pale warm cream wooden plaster-like wall panels framed by a few broad warm wood beams, not all brown. Sparse quiet sickroom with no patient. Single daylight source: modest square window upper LEFT at about logical (66,59), open view of clean green foliage and pale blue sky, no sunbeam or bloom. Low plain wooden bed at rear CENTER-RIGHT, cream pillow and neatly pulled sage-green blanket; EMPTY bed, absolutely no animal or person. Bed roughly logical x172..285 y88..141. Immediately LEFT of bed at (142,118) is a small warm wooden bedside TABLE. On table, a THICK CLOSED dark plum-brown worn patrol JOURNAL with visible cream page edge, no lettering, beside a small brass CANDLESTICK with a short unlit cream candle. Journal should be distinct but not oversized: about 13x9 logical pixels. Its lettered contents will be shown by game UI, not painted into background. Near journal a folded burgundy square cloth of similar size acts as a decoy decoration. One low shelf far left with exactly three plain spine books, a small pale ceramic pitcher on separate low stool, a simple rounded old wardrobe far right, small flat wall hook and folded cloth, one tiny leafy pot by window. Do not add complicated architecture, food or modern medical equipment. Lower quarter empty broad clean pale wood floor with very few hard-edged plank lines, ONE character can stand in front-left or front-right without covering table. Make emotionally quiet, caring lived-in room; bed unoccupied and covers FLAT, do not imply a body under blanket. No clock with numerals, no framed animal portrait.

DETECTIVE OFFICE BASEMENT HOLDING CELL, early morning 7:30. Second image shows Papa solely as a CLOTHING COLOR/SHAPE reference: draw ONLY his worn ochre-gold trenchcoat as a loose EMPTY coat, never the raccoon, hat, tie-wearing body or any character. Quiet humane old village holding room, not a frightening dungeon. Broad clean blue-grey stone rear wall, cream and slate accents, pale hard daylight through a small high LEFT window. A simple closed dark-grey iron barred cell door and broad barred partition at BACK LEFT/CENTER, x40..205 y65..145; 5-6 wide-spaced vertical bars, simple latch, no lock digits. Through bars, one EMPTY plain wooden bench and a folded dull green blanket, not a bed with body. RIGHT, clearly OUTSIDE bars in foreground-middle, a plain wooden desk around x218..315 y108..144. Papa's empty worn ochre trenchcoat is neatly spread OPEN on this desk, no wearer, no human shape. The outer coat flap lies to LEFT and has ONE visible exterior patch pocket with corner of a folded ivory HANDKERCHIEF protruding around logical (248,118). Turned-open right flap exposes burgundy lining and ONE inner chest pocket, showing just corner and cream edge of a SMALL CLOSED dark burgundy NOTEBOOK around (279,117). Make the two pocket areas spatially separate and readable as part of the SAME coat; no floating collectible item, not handkerchief or notebook placed on top of random folded cloth. The handkerchief is clean without black soot, notebook worn edges, no writing. Avoid massive shirt-like sleeves or empty coat hanging like an invisible person; laid-flat irregular folds. Compare evidence visual weight with one folded pale-blue cleaning cloth and one small dark wooden block or inkless plain box on a rear shelf, away from pockets. On desk at rear-right one small plain ceramic cup (no papers). Sparse grouping: high window, bars/door, empty bench, desk/coat, cup, rear shelf/cloth/box, 2 stone floor scuffs. Foreground lower 25% EMPTY slate floor with few large flagstones, one character placement front-left. No torch or second light source, no chains, weapons, prisoners, handcuffs, skulls, text or UI.

A HIGH OLD PINE TREE near the woodland village, late MORNING, secret location unlocked by investigation. No physical lock/chain, the gameplay lock is not part of art. Single tall pine trunk at center-right x205, rooted at y149; canopy made of only FOUR broad flat dark/medium green polygon-like needle tiers with stepped square edges, no thousands of individual needles. Show enough tree to understand nest is HIGH, not on ground. Canopy starts below top safe 8% margin, stretches roughly x142..285 y22..114; background pale clean blue sky, distant simplified forest at y120, empty grassy-earth lower quarter. At the END of a thick side branch emerging into a CLEAR canopy gap near logical (250,65) is a compact rough round BIRD NEST, just 6-8 simple straw strokes, width about40 logical pixels. It must be visibly high among branches and NOT at trunk base. Inside nest rests ONE heavy rounded faceted STARLIGHT STONE, warm pale gold/cream, solid pixel facets, about 12-15 logical pixels diameter, readable but no magic glow aura, no bloom or particles. It is the genuine warm-lit counterpart of approved hill's unlit round grey stone. Under stone, nestled into bottom straw, a BLACK ENVELOPE lies FLAT; only its charcoal edge and small triangular flap corner visibly peek out on right near (258,74). Do NOT draw the full envelope beside the nest, below tree or as a giant floating black rectangle. Envelope stamp and inside paper will be revealed by game close inspection; no symbol or lettering needed here. Dark pinecone and loose curled brown needle clump on same branch near but separate from nest act as comparable decorations; leaf shadows behind nest further camouflage dark envelope without concealing stone. On ground only one flat slate-grey rock left, a small fallen branch mid-left, 2 sparse fern/flower tufts near edges. No ladder, rope, squirrel, crow, empty animal icon, decorative lantern or UI. No characters stand here; still keep bottom area calm and empty consistent with other game scenes. All evidence well inside center crop safe zone. Straight-on stage, NO extreme upward camera or bird's-eye perspective.
